policy_note: Margins add ON TOP of AGENTS.md (833.333 ps at SS setup / FF hold, 60 ps setup / 25 ps hold uncertainty); die_ci.check_margins rejects any value that would relax the policy.

ocv.why: Flat OCV (OpenSTA set_timing_derate) because ASAP7 ships no LVF / POCV sigma tables. +/-5 % cell is the flat derate an AOCV table gives a ~10-stage path (the partition clock trees from the tap to the face flops are 8-14 stages; flat derates of 5-10 % are the usual range without LVF, cf. Bhasker & Chadha, Static Timing Analysis for Nanometer Designs, 2009, ch. 10 on OCV derating). +/-3 % on nets. CRPR only removes the common clock path; seams share only the die clk port (ideal spine), so the whole tree of each partition is derated -- the dominant term on a seam.

ir.why: No die-level PDN database exists yet (die_plan pg.grid is a plan; no placed die ODB with power for OpenROAD PDNSim / analyze_power_grid), so PDNSim is NOT RUN and a stated budget is used: 5 % of the SS supply (31.5 mV at 0.63 V, the total static + dynamic drop a sign-off PDN is designed to). Delay sensitivity from the alpha-power law (Sakurai & Newton, IEEE JSSC 25(2), 1990), t ~ V / (V - Vt)^a: d ln t / d ln V = 1 - a V / (V - Vt) = -1.155 at a = 1.3, Vt = 0.25 V (conservative ASAP7 RVT), so a 5 % drop is +5.8 % cell delay, applied as an extra LATE cell derate on data and clock (setup: late launch + data; hold: late capture clock). When a PDNSim result exists (pdnsim: {worst_drop_mv}) it replaces vdd_drop_frac.

xtalk.why: OpenSTA has no SI delay. Per-seam margin = |MCF - 1| x R_eff x Cc, Cc = cc_frac x c_per_um x L_seam: c_per_um = ASAP7 M4 0.178 fF/um (ORFS platforms/asap7/setRC.tcl, the seam pin layers M4-M7 are 0.163-0.187); cc_frac 0.7 = sidewall coupling share of a min-pitch 7 nm line with both neighbours (aspect ratio ~2); Miller coupling factor 2 (opposite switching, setup) / 0 (same direction, hold) is the worst-case switch-factor bound of Kahng, Muddu & Sarto (DAC 2000); L_seam = 2 x budgets.pin_reg_p90_um (R2 face flops at both pins, G3 pin-to-reg p90 budget, 30 um per side default); R_eff = the clk->QN delay slope of DFFHQNx1 at the corner (lib below). This is a bound for an x1 face flop driving the seam unbuffered; a kit that upsizes the seam driver lowers the real push. Clock-net coupling is not added (clock trees are inside the derated OCV term).
